items.author: PhilakoneCrypto
items.context: Philakone publica su resumen diario: BTC cerró en $64,921 tras tocar $63,301; Supertrend diario bajista, precio bajo las SMA 50 y 200, RSI 23.90. Soporte $61,956 y resistencia $81,188 (cifras del autor).
items.suggested_text: An RSI near 24 with price under both the 50 and 200 SMA is the kind of reading that makes everyone bearish at once. Useful context, but daily indicators describe the last few weeks, not the cycle. I'd rather zoom out to the long-term trend before deciding what this level means: https://x.com/forecastquant/status/2118779927340470279 $BTC

items.author: KCEX_Official
items.context: KCEX (exchange) dice que $BTC muestra señales de capitulación sin suelo confirmado: soporte clave $62K-$66K, compradores recientes sumaron ~66K BTC en esa zona, costo base de holders de corto plazo $74.1K; un cierre diario bajo $62K podría exponer $58.5K y el realized price de $53.7K (cifras del autor).
items.suggested_text: Short-term holders sitting on a $74.1K cost basis while price trades in the low $60Ks is where weak hands usually hand coins to patient ones. Whether $62K holds is the short-term question; the bigger one is whether you're positioned to not care. Spot, no leverage, keys in your own hands. $BTC

items.author: X_Four_iv
items.context: FOUR | Crypto Spaces explica en lenguaje simple cómo funciona la seguridad de Binance: fondos mayormente en cold storage, multisig/MPC, fondo SAFU (~15,000 BTC, ~US$1B, que no cubre phishing ni estafas) y límites de retiro con revisión manual; dice que 'tu parte' viene después.
items.suggested_text: All of that protects the platform. It doesn't change that the coins in your account are an IOU until you withdraw them, and withdrawal limits and manual review cut both ways. The vault analogy works, it's just someone else's vault. If you want your own, I wrote how to build an air-gapped setup yourself: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HQ5NS31N?dplnkId=c09ef739-11f3-4c76-8c62-92ce160a3341&nodl=1
